title: Rewards Partner LATAM
description:
Empresa está contratando Rewards Partner LATAM em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the role  Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business. Key responsibilities  Strategic Rewards Partner  Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness. Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity. Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness. Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions. Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.  Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner  Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM. Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance. Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope. Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management. Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees. Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.  Business & Operational Execution  Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives. Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes. Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities. Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.  Qualifications and skills  • A Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field) • Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing; Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable • English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking) About Kerry  Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Social Media
description:

VAGA: Social Media  Cooperlink Brasil – Presencial  Sobre a Cooperlink  Na Cooperlink, marketing não é estética; é crescimento e resultado mensurável. Aqui, criatividade existe para gerar impacto, e conteúdo bom é o que conecta, engaja e constrói presença de verdade. Buscamos uma profissional criativa, inovadora e com forte capacidade de execução, com repertório em produção de conteúdo e autonomia para transformar ideias em resultado. Missão do Cargo  Atuar na linha de frente da criação de conteúdo da Cooperlink, produzindo peças, vídeos e materiais institucionais com criatividade, ritmo e fidelidade à marca. Principais Responsabilidades:  Produzir conteúdo orgânico para as redes da Cooperlink (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube), incluindo posts, reels, stories e vídeos institucionais. Atuar como videomaker da operação, apoiando gravações e captações em parceria a equipe de mídia. Apoiar a criação de criativos e materiais institucionais junto a Design, Copy e Mídia. Aparecer em frente às câmeras com boa oratória e desenvoltura, conduzindo conteúdos, entrevistas internas e bastidores. Cumprir o calendário editorial dentro do prazo e do padrão de marca. Ler o desempenho das publicações com sensibilidade de redes para orientar as próximas execuções. Manter benchmarking ativo, acompanhando tendências e referências para aplicar rapidamente nas redes da marca. Executar ações pontuais de trade marketing, conduzindo cotação, busca de fornecedores e acompanhamento até a entrega final.  O que esperamos de você:  Experiência prática com criação de conteúdo para redes sociais. Boa oratória e desenvoltura em frente às câmeras. Perfil criativo e inovador, com repertório atualizado de tendências e formatos. Sensibilidade analítica de redes, com leitura básica do que funciona em cada plataforma. Perfil autodidata, que aprende rápido, testa e evolui sem depender de comando. Organização e capacidade de execução simultânea de múltiplas demandas. Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação, Audiovisual, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas.  Diferenciais que valorizamos:  Experiência com edição de vídeo (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci ou equivalentes) e de imagem (Photoshop, Canva, Figma). Familiaridade com motion graphics e legendagem dinâmica. Experiência prévia como videomaker ou criadora de conteúdo em marcas, agências ou projetos próprios. Vivência com fotografia e direção de arte para redes sociais. Experiência em segmentos de alta frequência de publicação (varejo, serviço, infoprodutos). Conhecimento em ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação de conteúdo (imagem, vídeo, voz e roteiro).  O que oferecemos  Benefícios informados durante o processo seletivo Oportunidade real de crescimento profissional Estrutura e equipamento à disposição para produção de conteúdo Contato direto com a liderança de marketing e participação em decisões de marca Ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante Gestão Meritocrática, com reconhecimento baseado em resultado  Por que essa vaga é diferente  Aqui, social media não é só "agendar post". É produzir, gravar, aparecer e criar com criatividade, ritmo e leitura de marca. Resultado gera reconhecimento, e a evolução profissional acompanha o valor entregue ao negócio.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. title: Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Empresa está contratando Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Position Overview  This role leads the technical writing, dossier compilation, and procedural management for genetically modified (GM) crops and gene-edited products (New Breeding Techniques - NBTs) in Brazil. The Lead will combine a process-driven mindset with solid scientific knowledge to draft regulatory submissions, manage Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), and author technical responses to CTNBio's official inquiries. Additionally, this position will drive regulatory intelligence and oversee VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use) trials required for variety registration with MAPA. Key Responsibilities:   Lead the preparation, technical writing, and assembly of scientific dossiers for commercial release and Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), ensuring full compliance with CTNBio standards. Act as the technical lead for analyzing and drafting precise, science-based responses to official inquiries and data requests from CTNBio members. Leverage a solid background in molecular biology to support regulatory strategies and technical rationales for gene-edited products, addressing official consultations for NBTs. Oversee the planning, data alignment, and administrative requirements for VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trials, ensuring the bridge between CTNBio biosafety approvals and National Cultivar Registration (RNC) with MAPA. Continuously monitor, analyze, and map changes in the Latin American regulatory landscape, competitive landscape (competitor pipeline), and evolving guidelines. Interface with global R&D teams to translate, adapt, and validate global data into the standard format required by Brazilian authorities.  Qualifications  PhD in Biotechnology, Biology or Agronomy, with minimum of 5 years relevant experience; MSc with minimum of 8 years relevant experience with a focus on molecular genetics. Proven experience in technical writing for biotechnology regulatory affairs in Brazil. Demonstrated track record in drafting CTNBio dossiers and handling official inquiries.  Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages. Familiarity with MAPA’s administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing. Attention to quality and detail-oriented. Efficient and timeline driven. Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills. Fluent in English and Portuguese is required for scientific data review and alignment with global R&D teams.

Deep knowledge of MAPA regulations, phytosanitary requirements, post-entry quarantine procedures, and domestic transit rules for biological materials. A posição está no centro da capacidade de execução de gôndola do CatExpert.Ai, transformando lógicas de clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo em planogramas capazes de gerar melhorias mensuráveis nos KPIs de varejo. A pessoa nessa função será a principal referência operacional para entrega de planogramas em seus mercados, impulsionando qualidade, velocidade e consistência em escala, fator essencial para suportar o crescimento do CatExpert.Ai rumo à geração simultânea de milhares de planogramas em mercados globais.  2. Principais Responsabilidades  Desenvolvimento e Entrega de Planogramas Criar e entregar versões de planogramas com base na clusterização de lojas, definições de espaço e diretrizes de fluxo aprovadas por cada mercado. Garantir que os planogramas sejam visualmente atrativos, comercialmente corretos e aderentes aos parâmetros de negócio e padrões de exposição definidos. Apoiar o objetivo de geração de planogramas em escala dentro do CatExpert.Ai, permitindo processamento paralelo de grande volume para múltiplos mercados simultaneamente. Manter controle de versões e documentação de todos os planogramas produzidos, assegurando rastreabilidade e auditoria das solicitações dos mercados.  Colaboração com Mercados e Gestão de Stakeholders  Atuar como principal parceiro operacional dos mercados em diferentes regiões, promovendo alinhamento e consistência na execução dos planogramas. Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Gestão por Categorias dos mercados para validar parâmetros dos planogramas e garantir impacto positivo nos resultados de negócio. Coletar e incorporar rapidamente feedbacks dos mercados, ajustando os planogramas conforme mudanças nas estratégias de exposição.  Excelência Operacional e Controle de Qualidade  Conduzir melhorias contínuas nos processos para aumentar eficiência, qualidade e velocidade de entrega dos planogramas. Identificar gargalos na construção dos planogramas e propor soluções, especialmente aquelas que possam ser resolvidas por meio das funcionalidades do CatExpert.Ai. Comparar a qualidade dos planogramas gerados com ferramentas concorrentes, como JDA, SpacePlano e ShelfIQ, sinalizando oportunidades de melhoria ao time de produto. Manter visibilidade clara sobre pipeline, cronogramas e status das entregas, comunicando proativamente avanços e impedimentos aos stakeholders.  3. Qualificações, Experiência e Competências  Formação Acadêmica Ensino superior completo. Formação em Administração, Gestão do Varejo ou áreas correlatas será considerada diferencial. Experiência prática com planejamento de layout de lojas e otimização de espaços de vendas. Histórico comprovado de entrega de planogramas para múltiplos mercados ou contas varejistas simultaneamente. Experiência de trabalho com equipes de Gestão por Categorias ou Trade Marketing em empresas de bens de consumo (CPG/FMCG).  Desejável  Experiência com ferramentas de planogramas baseadas em inteligência artificial ou plataformas de automação. Conhecimento de metodologias de clusterização de lojas e sua aplicação na definição de espaço de gôndola. Experiência em ambientes globais ou multinacionais, atuando com stakeholders de diferentes culturas.  Idiomas  Inglês:  nível intermediário. Português ou Espanhol:  nível avançado/proficiente.   4. Competências Técnicas  Obrigatórias Proficiência em softwares de planejamento de espaço como JDA, Spaceman, Hoffrogge  ou equivalentes. Excel avançado, incluindo manipulação de dados, tabelas dinâmicas e relatórios. Sólido conhecimento de parâmetros de conformidade de planogramas, métricas de gôndola (facings, capacidade, fluxo) e KPIs de varejo. Capacidade de interpretar layouts físicos de loja e resultados de clusterização.  Desejáveis  Experiência com o CatExpert.Ai  ou plataformas semelhantes de gestão por categorias baseadas em IA. Conhecimentos básicos de SQL ou consultas de dados para extração de informações de vendas e espaço. Familiaridade com ferramentas de validação de planogramas por imagem. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.   Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.    Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.    Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.    Other duties, as assigned.   Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up    POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.   Other Skills (Desirable):  Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.  Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.  Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.   English level required:  C1 or above  Portuguese level required:  none for teachers instructing in English  C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese   Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.   EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages. Familiarity with MAPA’s administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing. Attention to quality and detail-oriented. Efficient and timeline driven. Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills. ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.  A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.  Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.  E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.  Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up     POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese    Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.    EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.   A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.    Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.    E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.    Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.   Core Responsibilities:   Student Support & Intervention   Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students' plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC's Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.    Collaboration   Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students' progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students' learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.    Operational and Professional Conduct   Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.    Other duties, as assigned.   Working Conditions:   Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up    POSITION REQUIREMENTS   Minimum Education Required:   BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:   Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:   Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC's Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):   Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:   C1 or above   Portuguese level required:   none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese   Child Safeguarding   Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.   EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion   EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. Participação em projetos de transição, centralização ou transformação de processos. Conhecimento básico em remuneração baseada em ações, tributação e impactos em folha de pagamento será considerado um diferencial. Excelente organização e foco em qualidade de dados.   Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e cumprir prazos.   Facilidade para atuar em processos estruturados, controles e auditorias.   Capacidade de documentar processos com clareza e coordenar stakeholders diversos.   Boa avaliação de riscos, senso crítico e habilidade para identificar situações que demandam escalonamento. A posição terá contato frequente com clientes, fornecedores, transportadoras, despachantes aduaneiros e com a matriz internacional, apoiando principalmente os processos de vendas, pedidos, faturamento, compras internacionais, importação, logística e comunicação em inglês.   Procuramos uma pessoa organizada, responsável, comunicativa e hands-on, com interesse em desenvolver uma carreira em uma empresa internacional e em um ambiente dinâmico. Comunicação em Inglês e Suporte à Matriz   Manter comunicação diária, em português e inglês, com a matriz internacional, fornecedores e parceiros;   Participar de reuniões virtuais e presenciais em inglês, auxiliando na comunicação e no alinhamento das informações;   Apoiar, quando necessário, a comunicação entre colaboradores brasileiros e estrangeiros durante reuniões, visitas e atividades operacionais;   Redigir e traduzir e-mails, relatórios, atas de reunião, documentos e comunicações internas em Português ↔ Inglês;   Apoiar executivos e visitantes internacionais durante reuniões, visitas a clientes, fornecedores e demais atividades no Brasil.   4. title: Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview   This role leads the technical writing, dossier compilation, and procedural management for genetically modified (GM) crops and gene-edited products (New Breeding Techniques - NBTs) in Brazil. The Lead will combine a process-driven mindset with solid scientific knowledge to draft regulatory submissions, manage Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), and author technical responses to CTNBio's official inquiries. Additionally, this position will drive regulatory intelligence and oversee VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use) trials required for variety registration with MAPA.   Key Responsibilities:   Lead the preparation, technical writing, and assembly of scientific dossiers for commercial release and Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), ensuring full compliance with CTNBio standards.   Act as the technical lead for analyzing and drafting precise, science-based responses to official inquiries and data requests from CTNBio members.   Leverage a solid background in molecular biology to support regulatory strategies and technical rationales for gene-edited products, addressing official consultations for NBTs.   Oversee the planning, data alignment, and administrative requirements for VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trials, ensuring the bridge between CTNBio biosafety approvals and National Cultivar Registration (RNC) with MAPA.   Continuously monitor, analyze, and map changes in the Latin American regulatory landscape, competitive landscape (competitor pipeline), and evolving guidelines.   Interface with global R&D teams to translate, adapt, and validate global data into the standard format required by Brazilian authorities.    Qualifications   PhD in Biotechnology, Biology or Agronomy, with minimum of 5 years relevant experience; MSc with minimum of 8 years relevant experience with a focus on molecular genetics.   Proven experience in technical writing for biotechnology regulatory affairs in Brazil. Demonstrated track record in drafting CTNBio dossiers and handling official inquiries.   Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages.   Familiarity with MAPA's administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing.   Attention to quality and detail-oriented.   Efficient and timeline driven.   Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills.   Fluent in English and Portuguese is required for scientific data review and alignment with global R&D teams.

A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Learning support teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Learning support teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.      Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Team Leadership  – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products. Data Analysis  – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product. title: Analista de Projetos PL
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Analista de Projetos PL em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Overview Venha construir o futuro com o GRI Institute!  No GRI Institute , somos movidos por propósito: conectar líderes globais e criar pontes entre diferentes mercados, indústrias e culturas. Nosso time atua na linha de frente da inovação em networking estratégico, eventos de alto impacto e desenvolvimento de conhecimento , sempre com o compromisso de gerar valor real para executivos e instituições em todo o mundo. Fazer parte de uma empresa internacional , com alcance em diversos países. Ter contato direto com líderes e decisores globais . Atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, que valoriza criatividade, colaboração e excelência . Crescer profissionalmente em um espaço que incentiva autonomia, inovação e impacto positivo . Se você busca um lugar onde suas ideias são ouvidas, seus talentos são reconhecidos e suas conquistas contribuem para transformar o futuro dos negócios, o GRI Institute é o seu próximo passo!  Aqui, cada desafio é uma oportunidade de crescer.  Requisitos Experiência como Gestão de Projetos Perfil estratégico e não apenas executor Capaz de gerenciar mudanças constantes (perfil startup) Boa comunicação interpessoal Nível de organização alto Inglês avançado  Atividades Visão e Relatórios: Fornecer uma visão ampla e atualizada sobre o status de todos os projetos e stakeholders, reportando-se diretamente ao Managing Director da divisão. Gestão de Projetos: Analisar volume, prazos e status das tarefas, antecipando problemas de eficiência e propondo soluções ágeis. Planejamento Estratégico: Participar ativamente da definição de metas, budget e estratégias da divisão, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Distribuição e Organização de Recursos: Planejar e distribuir os projetos entre diferentes equipes do back office, de forma estratégica e analítica. Engajamento e Execução: Engajar as equipes na execução das atividades e no alcance das metas estabelecidas. Acompanhamento e Cobrança: Monitorar o status das tarefas, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e cobrando entregas quando necessário. Otimização de Processos: Dominar ferramentas de gestão de projetos para facilitar a organização, otimizar resultados e oferecer uma visão integrada. Gestão de Riscos: Identificar e comunicar riscos envolvidos nos projetos, propondo ações preventivas ou corretivas. Gerenciamento de Mudanças: Adaptar e reestruturar o planejamento conforme necessário para garantir o sucesso dos projetos.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença.  Previdência privada  Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.  Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). Conta remunerada : CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI.  Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital.  Credito do Trabalhador : taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa.  Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS.  Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Gestão de eventos críticos e boas práticas de monitoração proativa.  Habilidades comportamentais:  Liderança e postura estratégica em momentos de crise, com comunicação clara e assertiva. Raciocínio analítico e atenção a detalhes. Comunicação objetiva e clara. Capacidade analítica e foco em detalhes, especialmente sob pressão.  O seu dia a dia:  Supervisionar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, garantindo eficiência e qualidade no acompanhamento de ambientes críticos. Atuar no acionamento e coordenação de times técnicos em incidentes, priorizando a rápida mitigação de impactos. Conduzir war rooms e follow-ups estruturados em crises, produzindo relatórios e indicadores executivos. Promover a melhoria contínua de dashboards, alertas e processos de monitoramento, em parceria com áreas técnicas. Atualizar e manter documentação, playbooks e análises post-mortem, assegurando governança e lições aprendidas.  O que oferecemos:  Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade); Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).  Conheça um pouco sobre nós:  Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro. Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas. A Mecânico Delivery trabalha todos os dias da semana, inclusive feriados, mas o mecânico define os dias e horários que deseja receber propostas de serviços. Não exigimos dedicação exclusiva. A jornada de trabalho é flexível, e o mecânico aceita apenas as propostas nos dias e horários desejados. description:

Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 8,000 CI&MTSers ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1,000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.  Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequência vigente.  Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados para atuar de forma protagonista na migração (“tombamento”) de dados de dois sistemas legados para um novo sistema que está sendo construído.  Responsabilidades   Desenhar, implementar e liderar o processo de extração, transformação e carga (ETL/ELT), garantindo a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados durante toda a fase de transição, até a desativação completa dos sistemas legados.  Liderar o processo de mapeamento e entendimento dos dados dos sistemas legados (modelo de dados, regras de negócio, volumetria, qualidade).  Definir e implementar a estratégia de tombamento de dados entre as bases, considerando:      Transformações necessárias  Regras de consolidação, limpeza e padronização  Estratégia de migração (big bang, incremental, paralela etc.)      Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados (batch e/ou near real-time) para garantir que o novo sistema seja continuamente abastecido até a desativação dos legados.  Construir rotinas de ETL/ELT para extração, transformação e carga de dados entre diferentes tecnologias de banco e formatos.  Garantir governança de dados: rastreabilidade, versionamento de scripts, documentação técnica e dados de referência.  Implementar processos de validação, reconciliação e qualidade de dados (checks, logs, monitoramento, auditoria).  Atuar em parceria com desenvolvedores do novo sistema, analistas de negócio e times de infraestrutura, alinhando regras de migração e cronograma.  Apoiar na definição de padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de dados reutilizáveis para futuras migrações ou integrações.    Requisitos   Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados (ou função equivalente) com foco em migração/tombamento de dados entre sistemas diferentes.  Vivência em modelagem de dados (relacional e/ou dimensional).  Domínio de SQL (consultas complexas, otimização, criação de procedures, views, funções).  Experiência na construção de pipelines ETL/ELT usando alguma(s) das ferramentas/tecnologias:      Ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, Azkaban)  Ferramentas de integração/ETL (ex.: Talend, Pentaho, DataStage, SSIS) ou pipelines em código (Python/Scala/Java)      Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server).  Conhecimentos em versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (testes, code review, documentação).  Capacidade de analisar e interpretar regras de negócio para traduzi-las em regras de transformação de dados.    Diferenciais   Experiência prévia com desativação de sistemas legados e planos de transição/migração em fases.  Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS) e seus serviços de dados.  Experiência com ferramentas de monitoração e observabilidade de pipelines (logs, alertas, dashboards).  Vivência com governança e qualidade de dados (Data Quality, Data Lineage, Catálogo de Dados).  Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).    Nossos benefícios   Plano de saúde e odontológico;  Vale alimentação e refeição;  Auxílio‑creche;  Licença parental estendida;  Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem‑estar via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;  Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);  Seguro de Vida;  Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);  Clube de descontos;  Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem‑estar;  Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;  Parceria com plataformas de cursos online;  Plataforma para aprendizagem de idiomas;  E muitos outros.    Mais detalhes sobre os nossos benefícios aqui:   Na CI&T, a inclusão começa no primeiro contato. Se você é pessoa com deficiência, é importante apresentar o seu laudo durante o processo seletivo. Consulte quais dados são necessários conter no laudo clicando aqui. Assim, podemos garantir o suporte e as adaptações que você merece. Se ainda não tem o laudo caracterizador, não se preocupe: podemos te apoiar para obtê-lo.  Temos um time dedicado de Saúde e Bem‑estar, especialistas em inclusão e grupos de afinidade que estarão com você em todas as etapas. Conte com a gente para fazer essa jornada lado a lado.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Commercial Strategy Specialist
description:

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About ABI Growth Group  ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.  This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.  Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at   About the Role  The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.  What you'll do   Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.  Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.  Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependency on ad hoc judgement and improve process consistency.  Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.  Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.  Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.  Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.  Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.  Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.    What you'll need   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.  Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.  Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.  Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.  Demonstrated experience with take rate modelling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.  Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.  Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.  Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.  Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus. Diagnóstico de Maturidade: Identificar o momento da empresa (ex: dores de crescimento, problemas fiscais, falta de controle de estoque, necessidade de governança para auditorias).  Posicionamento de Valor Pragmático: Demonstrar como o ERP TOTVS e as soluções complementares de todo o nosso portfólio resolvem as dores imediatas da operação e preparam a empresa para o próximo salto de faturamento. Entrega de Metas: Garantir o atingimento das metas de novos clientes (New Business), receita, margem e penetração de produtos paralelos (ex: Techfin, RH, etc). This role requires expertise in Brazilian labor law, tax regulations, and payroll systems to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing. Responsibilities / Tasks Payroll Processing Process bi‑weekly and monthly payroll for 298 employees in compliance with Brazilian labor laws (CLT). Calculate wages, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and deductions accurately. Manage vacation pay (férias), 13th salary (décimo terceiro), and FGTS calculations. Manage meal vouchers (vale alimentação/refeição) and transportation vouchers (vale transporte). Calculate and process profit‑sharing (PLR) distributions. Coordinate with benefits providers for enrollment and changes.   System Management and Data Integrity Maintain payroll system data accuracy and employee information updates. Generate payroll reports for management and accounting teams. Reconcile payroll accounts and resolve discrepancies. Backup and secure payroll data in compliance with data protection regulations (LGPD).   Employee Support Respond to employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, and benefits. Provide pay stub explanations and wage statements. Assist with employment verification requests. Support HR with compensation‑related queries and eSocial, Conectividade Social processes.    Your Profile / Qualifications Preferred Qualifications Experience with multi‑location payroll processing. Knowledge of international payroll concepts. Familiarity with LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados) compliance. Experience with payroll audits and government inspections.  Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business Administration, or related field. Minimum 3‑5 years of payroll processing experience in Brazil. Experience managing payroll for 200+ employees preferred.  Technical Skills Expert knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets with complex formulas and pivot tables. Experience with ERP systems for payroll integration. Familiarity with electronic governance.  Core Competencies Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines. Excellent organizational and time‑management skills. Professional discretion with confidential information. English is mandatory (Spanish is a plus).    #J-18808-Ljbffr
