title: Staff Product Engineer (Campinas)
description:
Empresa está contratando Staff Product Engineer (Campinas) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Overview  This is a remote role for candidates located in Campinas, Brazil.  LawnStarter is the nation’s leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We’re expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services — operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform.  About Engineering at LawnStarter  We’re restructuring engineering around initiative teams: a Product Engineer paired with a PM and a designer, with an Engineering Manager who covers a couple of initiatives and supports your growth. The engineer leads AI agents like a team, ships the work, and is accountable — with the rest of the triangle — for whether the initiative moves its metric.  We’re betting that 1–2 strong engineers running AI agents can outship the labor-team model that defined the last decade of software. That bet only works if the engineers we hire are wired for ownership and can ship to a marketplace with real customers and pros on both sides.  The Role  You’re the engineering anchor of one initiative at a time. The initiative is a team effort — an iron triangle of you, your PM, and your designer — and you have key participation across the full lifecycle: shaping the problem, deciding the technical approach, leading the AI agents that implement most of the code, shipping to production, and answering for the outcome alongside the rest of the triangle.  You’re accountable for the outcome — not for the volume of code merged. If an agent can ship it safely, your job is to make sure the agent does it right and the metric moves. If the initiative needs hand-written code in a sensitive area, you write it yourself.  What makes this role different:   You lead AI agents, not humans. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and our internal agent stack are your team. You own the quality, safety, and velocity of what they produce.  You own an outcome, not a ticket queue. Problem-framing through production through the metric review 2–4 weeks after launch.  You partner horizontally with PM and design. No tech lead above you. No architect approval. No ticket grooming committee.  The bar is staff, not senior. You make the call when the call needs to be made. If you’re waiting to be told, this isn’t the role.    What You’ll Own   The technical approach  — architecture, data model, integration choices, rollout plan, observability, and rollback strategy for your initiative. You make the call, document it, and revisit it if the data says you were wrong.  Agent-led implementation quality  — the prompts, guardrails, evals, tests, and review loop that let agents ship safe, correct, production-ready code on your initiative. Most lines will be agent-authored. You’re accountable for them.  Cross-functional partnership  — daily working contact with your PM (scope, tradeoffs) and your designer (UX decisions, in-tool prototyping with agents), and weekly check-ins with your EM (initiative health, blockers, growth).  The initiative outcome  — the specific metric the initiative was set up to move. In partnership with your PM, you present results 2–4 weeks post-launch and share the “did it work” answer.  A high bar for what ships under your name  — production correctness, security posture, performance, observability, and the experience for customers and pros. Agents accelerate you; they don’t lower the bar.    Problems to Solve  Leading AI agents at staff-level quality  — Most of the code on your initiative will be authored by AI agents. The work is making agents ship as if a senior engineer wrote it: prompts that encode our codebase conventions, evals that catch hallucinations before merge, tests that exercise the edges, observability that catches the regression in production before a customer reports it. How do you build the agent workflow that lets one engineer ship what used to take a team?  Owning an outcome without a tech lead  — You don’t have a tech lead to approve your design or an architect to escalate to. You have an EM who covers a couple of initiatives and peers on adjacent ones. How do you make calls fast, document them clearly, and stay accountable to the outcome — without slowing down for hierarchy that no longer exists?  Shipping outcomes, not features  — The initiative will be measured by a metric — a conversion rate, a retention curve, a pro-funnel KPI, a unit economics shift. You’re accountable for the number, not the feature. How do you scope to actually move it, decide what to build, and have the discipline to follow up 2–4 weeks after launch even when the next initiative is calling?  What Success Looks Like (Year 1)   Initiative outcomes hit  — You’ve shipped 3–4 initiatives end-to-end, and at least two clearly moved the metric they were set up to move (with the post-launch review to prove it).  Agent workflow that travels  — The prompts, evals, and review loop you built for your initiative are adopted by at least one other engineer on an adjacent initiative.  Cycle time  — Median time from problem-framing to first production rollout on your initiatives is meaningfully shorter than the pre-restructure baseline.  Zero agent-shipped that incidents  — No customer- or pro-facing regression traceable to agent-authored code that you missed in review.  Visible leverage  — Other engineers point to artifacts you left behind — runbooks, evals, agent workflows, post-launch write-ups — as references they use.    Who You Are  AI-native.  Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent are how you ship — daily, on production work. You have opinions about prompts, evals, agent loops, MCP servers, and review workflows, and you know when to let the agent run vs. write it yourself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you describe AI coding as “something you’re exploring” or prefer to write everything by hand.  Already operating at lead level.  You may currently be titled Senior, Staff, Lead, or Principal — but in practice you’ve been the person making the call, shipping the hard thing, and answering for whether it worked. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’ve always had a tech lead breaking down the work for you.  Outcome-driven, not output-driven.  You measure your week in “did the metric move” and “did the experience get better,” not in tickets closed. You read the post-launch dashboard and you own the answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you take pride in volume of code shipped or feel uncomfortable being measured on a number you don’t fully control.  A strong horizontal partner.  You hold your own with a strong PM and a strong designer. You bring engineering judgment to product calls and product judgment to engineering calls. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you hide behind “that’s product’s decision” or default to RICE-scoring tickets handed down to you.  Decisive and documented.  Architecture decisions, data-model choices, rollout plans — you write them down, get fast input, and move. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you wait for consensus on questions that have a clear right answer, or if you make calls and never write them down.  Raises the floor, not just the ceiling.  Your impact compounds beyond your own initiative because you leave artifacts — agent workflows, evals, runbooks, post-launch reviews. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’re a lone wolf who ships brilliantly but leaves nothing reusable behind.  Cares about customers and pros.  This is a real-world marketplace with real people on both sides. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you’re chasing pure engineering elegance over business and customer outcomes.  This Role Is NOT    A tech lead in an old-style team.  No 4–5 engineers reporting up to you on technical direction. The team is you + PM + designer + EM, with AI agents doing most of the implementation.  A management role today.  People management is the EM’s job in this role. That said, the path can grow into management for those who want it — it’s an open door, not a closed one.  A platform-only or architecture-only role.  You’re a Product Engineer. You ship features that move metrics, end-to-end. Platform work happens inside the initiative when it’s needed for the outcome.  A “let AI do everything” role.  Agents handle implementation grunt work. You handle judgment, design, safety, and accountability. The bar is higher than the old senior bar, not lower.  A research role.  This is shipping to a marketplace with $100M+ in bookings. Customers and pros are using what you ship inside the same week.    Tech You’ll Touch   AI agents  — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, internal agent stack, MCP servers, evals tooling  Frontend  — TypeScript/React/React Native (customer & pro apps, web and mobile)  Documentation & process  — Brain (Claude Code skills + docs repo), Confluence, Jira    You don’t need every box checked. You need deep skill in at least one of our stacks plus credible production experience with AI coding agents.   Competitive salary of USD $80,000–$100,000 annual base  Work from anywhere  High ownership and autonomy  Fast-moving team that loves to build, learn, and grow     #J-18808-Ljbffr

The Role  CI&T is seeking a Marketing Operations & Performance Manager to lead the operational systems, processes, and reporting that support marketing for North America.  Based in Brazil, this role manages a marketing operations team responsible for marketing systems, campaign infrastructure, and performance reporting that enable demand generation campaigns, ABM initiatives, events, and digital programs to run efficiently.  You will work closely with marketing leadership, GTM managers, sales leaders, and cross-functional teams to ensure marketing programs are executed, tracked, and measured effectively.  This role focuses on strengthening marketing execution through scalable systems, clear lead management processes, and performance insights that support continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness and pipeline contribution.  Key Responsibilities  Leadership & Operational Coordination   Lead marketing operations supporting North America while managing, mentoring, and developing a Brazil-based marketing operations team.  Establish and manage marketing intake and operational workflows that prioritize requests and align teams on timelines, deliverables, and resources.  Coordinate operational support across campaigns, events, and GTM initiatives in partnership with marketing leadership and cross‑functional teams.    Sales & Funnel Governance   Partner with Sales leadership to ensure strong alignment between marketing and sales on lead lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, and funnel management.  Maintain governance over MQL, SAL, and opportunity definitions, ensuring clarity and consistency across teams.  Monitor funnel health and conversion performance, identifying areas where process improvements or campaign adjustments are needed.    Marketing Systems & Infrastructure   Identify opportunities to improve marketing systems, automation, and operational processes to increase efficiency and scalability.  Partner with internal technology teams, when needed, to implement system improvements that support marketing scalability.    Performance Data & Insights   Work with analysts to synthesize campaign and funnel data into strategic insights that guide marketing investment decisions.  Monitor website performance, search visibility, and engagement metrics, providing insights that support SEO, GEO, and AI‑driven search optimization (AEO) initiatives.  Identify trends in lead quality, engagement, and pipeline performance to inform improvements in targeting and campaign strategy.  Provide leadership with clear, actionable reporting that connects marketing activity to business outcomes.    Campaign Operations & Governance   Establish and maintain campaign operational standards, including performance measurement guidelines.  Ensure campaigns are structured to support audience targeting, lead capture, and funnel progression across marketing programs.    Process Optimization & Global Alignment   Identify bottlenecks across marketing processes and recommend improvements that increase speed, clarity, and cross‑team coordination.  Collaborate closely with CI&T’s global marketing operations team to ensure systems, processes, and reporting align with enterprise standards.    Qualifications  Required   6–8 years of experience in marketing operations within a B2B environment  Fluent or highly proficient in English, with the ability to work effectively with North America–based teams.  Experience managing marketing operations or campaign execution teams  Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and intent platforms such as HubSpot, Pipedrive, 6sense, Demandbase, or similar tools  Experience supporting demand generation, ABM, or integrated marketing programs  Experience managing marketing data analytics, attribution models, and funnel reporting  Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously  Experience working in technology, consulting, or digital services environments  Experience supporting global marketing organizations with distributed teams, strongly preferred    Location  This role is based in Campinas or Sao Paulo, Brazil , working closely with marketing and sales teams across North America. Based in Brazil, this role manages a marketing operations team responsible for marketing systems, campaign infrastructure, and performance reporting that enable demand generation campaigns, ABM initiatives, events, and digital programs to run efficiently.  You will work closely with marketing leadership, GTM managers, sales leaders, and cross‑functional teams to ensure marketing programs are executed, tracked, and measured effectively.  This role focuses on strengthening marketing execution through scalable systems, clear lead management processes, and performance insights that support continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness and pipeline contribution. Establish and manage marketing intake and operational workflows that prioritize requests and align teams on timelines, deliverables, and resources.  Coordinate operational support across campaigns, events, and GTM initiatives in partnership with marketing leadership and cross‑functional teams.    Sales & Funnel Governance   Partner with Sales leadership to ensure strong alignment between marketing and sales on lead lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, and funnel management.  Maintain governance over MQL, SAL, and opportunity definitions, ensuring clarity and consistency across teams.  Monitor funnel health and conversion performance, identifying areas where process improvements or campaign adjustments are needed.    Marketing Systems & Infrastructure   Identify opportunities to improve marketing systems, automation, and operational processes to increase efficiency and scalability.  Partner with internal technology teams, when needed, to implement system improvements that support marketing scalability.    Performance Data & Insights   Work with analysts to synthesize campaign and funnel data into strategic insights that guide marketing investment decisions.  Monitor website performance, search visibility, and engagement metrics, providing insights that support SEO, GEO, and AI‑driven search optimization (AEO) initiatives.  Identify trends in lead quality, engagement, and pipeline performance to inform improvements in targeting and campaign strategy.  Provide leadership with clear, actionable reporting that connects marketing activity to business outcomes.    Campaign Operations & Governance   Establish and maintain campaign operational standards, including performance measurement guidelines.  Ensure campaigns are structured to support audience targeting, lead capture, and funnel progression across marketing programs.    Process Optimization & Global Alignment   Identify bottlenecks across marketing processes and recommend improvements that increase speed, clarity, and cross‑team coordination. Responsabilidades   Desenvolvimento de Modelos Preditivos: Desenvolver modelos de propensão a default utilizando técnicas de ML tradicional (classificação binária, modelos ensemble como Random Forest, Gradient Boosting e equivalentes), com foco em precisão, recall e estabilidade em produção.  Seleção e Engenharia de Features: Conduzir análise exploratória de dados (EDA), identificar e selecionar variáveis relevantes a partir de dados contratuais estruturados e, progressivamente, incorporar variáveis externas (clima, safra, cenário macroeconômico, dados de recuperação judicial e fontes de notícias).  Experimentação no Databricks: Desenvolver e versionar experimentos de modelagem utilizando Databricks e MLflow, garantindo rastreabilidade de runs, parâmetros, métricas e artefatos de modelos ao longo dos ciclos iterativos.  Validação e Avaliação de Modelos: Projetar e executar estratégias robustas de validação (cross-validation, backtesting temporal, análise de estabilidade de score) garantindo que os modelos performem de forma confiável em janelas de projeção crescentes (3, 6 e 12 meses).  Ciclos Iterativos de Melhoria: Participar ativamente dos ciclos iterativos de refinamento do modelo — a cada sprint, incorporar novas variáveis, reavaliar performance e documentar aprendizados na Base de Conhecimento do programa.  Colaboração com Engenharia de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita parceria com os Data Engineers para garantir que os pipelines de dados alimentem corretamente os modelos, e que as saídas dos modelos (scores, projeções, alertas) sejam disponibilizadas nas camadas corretas da plataforma.  Comunicação de Resultados: Traduzir resultados técnicos dos modelos para linguagem de negócio, apoiando o Data Strategist na comunicação com stakeholders do cliente (superintendências, crédito, liderança).  Documentação Técnica: Documentar metodologias, decisões de modelagem e resultados em formatos estruturados que alimentem a Base de Conhecimento e possam ser consumidos por agentes de IA em fases subsequentes.  Monitoramento em Produção: Acompanhar a performance dos modelos em produção, identificar desvios de distribuição (data drift, concept drift) e propor ações corretivas ou re-treinamentos. Sólido domínio de seleção de features, tratamento de dados desbalanceados e estratégias de validação temporal para modelos de risco.  Experiência em análise e modelagem de dados no ecossistema AWS (S3, Athena, SageMaker ou serviços equivalentes de ML gerenciado em nuvem).  Capacidade de comunicar resultados e limitações de modelos para audiências não técnicas, com clareza e orientação para decisão de negócio. Experiência com modelos de crédito agrícola ou segmentos com sazonalidade e variáveis externas de clima e safra.  Familiaridade com incorporação de dados não estruturados em pipelines de modelagem (NLP, embeddings, dados de mídia). description:

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de Estratégia em Digital PR! Você tem facilidade para construir relacionamentos e adora transformar autoridade de marca em resultados orgânicos tangíveis? Gosta de unir comunicação persuasiva, conteúdo estratégico e análise de dados (SEO/GEO) para impulsionar a visibilidade de grandes marcas? Então essa vaga é a sua oportunidade de fazer parte de um time que pensa grande e entrega valor de verdade. Sobre a posição Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Digital PR Pleno com visão analítica e profundo foco em autoridade digital. Seu papel será liderar taticamente campanhas de aquisição de links e menções de marca, conectando o relacionamento com a mídia (sites, portais, blogs) às estratégias de SEO e GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Você atuará construindo pontes para que os conteúdos dos nossos clientes sejam referenciados, fortalecendo os pilares de E-E-A-T (Experiência, Especialidade, Autoridade e Confiabilidade). O que você vai fazer no dia a dia Planejar e executar campanhas estratégicas de Digital PR e Link Building (Data-driven PR, menções de marca, guest posts) alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio e SEO dos clientes. Construir, nutrir e expandir o relacionamento com jornalistas, veículos de comunicação, influenciadores de nicho e portais do mercado. Criar estratégias para conectar nossos clientes com oportunidades de mercado, em conjunto com o time de PR do cliente. Desenvolver pautas (pitches) criativas e embasadas em dados que atraiam cobertura orgânica e links naturais de alta qualidade. Realizar outreach (prospecção ativa) e follow-up para garantir publicações e menções da marca. Se relacionar com publishers e veículos de mercado. Analisar o perfil de links dos clientes (e concorrentes) para identificar gaps de autoridade e novas oportunidades de aquisição. Trabalhar em sinergia com os times de Conteúdo e Estratégia, garantindo que as ações de PR reforcem as páginas e termos estratégicos. Monitorar métricas de PR e autoridade (Domain Authority, Trust Flow, tráfego de referência, conversões assistidas), elaborando relatórios de impacto e sugerindo otimizações contínuas. Organização e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas aos clientes.  O que esperamos de você Experiência prévia e comprovada (nível pleno) em Digital PR, Assessoria de Imprensa focada em digital ou Link Building estratégico. Compreensão de como as relações públicas impactam diretamente o SEO (construção de autoridade) e o novo cenário de respostas de Inteligência Artificial (GEO). Excelente capacidade de escrita e argumentação persuasiva (saber vender uma pauta para um jornalista). Visão analítica, com capacidade de focar em como o PR gera impacto no negócio. Autonomia para gerenciar múltiplas campanhas para lidar com a dinâmica do outreach e negociações de mídia. Organização e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas aos clientes.  Conhecimentos técnicos desejáveis Ferramentas de SEO e análise de backlinks (Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic). Google Search Console e GA4 (para mensurar o impacto do tráfego de referência e conversões). Ferramentas de prospecção, CRM ou mailing (Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Comunique-se, Meltwater). Google Planilhas / Excel (nível intermediário/avançado para gestão de bases de contatos e relatórios). Conhecimento profundo das diretrizes de qualidade do Google (especialmente os fatores que compõem o E-E-A-T).  Habilidades e competências comportamentais Excelente comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, resiliência, poder de persuasão, raciocínio lógico, atenção aos detalhes, organização, planejamento e proatividade. Buscamos alguém com perfil "mão na massa", que saiba transitar entre a criatividade de uma boa pauta e de analisar os dados de ranqueamento. Nosso jeito de ser (fit cultural WE) Protagonismo com método: acreditamos na autonomia com responsabilidade. Aqui, você não é apenas um executor; você tem espaço e confiança para conduzir suas estratégias e gerenciar suas entregas, sempre amparado pelo nosso rigor técnico e processos bem definidos. Visão orientada a negócios: não trabalhamos com métricas de vaidade. Nosso foco, e o que celebramos internamente, é a capacidade de transformar dados e relacionamento em impacto real e mensurável para o cliente. O que fazemos gera valor de verdade. Excelência compartilhada: o conhecimento só tem poder quando é transferido. Cultivamos um ambiente maduro e de portas abertas, onde especialistas de diferentes áreas trocam experiências e se apoiam mutuamente para elevar o nível técnico de todo o time.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

JOB MISSION  HwIT is seeking a Packaging & Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules — from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands‑on environment bridging R&D design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro‑assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.  SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES  1. Product Development and Validation   Mechanical & Optomechanical Design for Packaging:  Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high‑precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GD&T standards.  Multiphysics & Thermal Simulation:  Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  Prototyping & Design Validation:  Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR‑468, MIL‑STD).    2. Process Development and Validation   Critical Parameter Optimization:  Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  Encapsulation Techniques:  Develop hermetic and semi‑hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  Material Qualification:  Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high‑reliability standards.    3. This role is centered on driving platform adoption through hands‑on engagement with users , ensuring that every solution built aligns with our architectural standards, best practices, and long‑term vision.  You will guide a team that works directly with internal customers – responding to adoption tickets, understanding technical requirements in depth, and collaboratively designing solutions that are robust, scalable, and compliant with our data and ML standards. high‑quality handling of adoption requests, technical tickets, and user onboarding journeys  Guide the team in deeply understanding user needs, translating them into well‑architected solutions aligned with platform standards  Act as a technical escalation point, supporting complex use cases and ensuring consistency in solution design across regions  Drive platform adoption through hands‑on collaboration: solution design sessions, architecture reviews, and iterative problem solving with users  Define and enforce reference architectures, guardrails, and reusable patterns to ensure scalable and standardized implementations  Balance user flexibility and platform governance, ensuring adherence to security, data governance, and ML best practices  Partner with product, platform, and business stakeholders to continuously improve the adoption experience and remove friction  Establish clear operational excellence across ticket lifecycle, prioritization, and delivery quality  Promote a culture of pragmatism, quality, and measurable impact in all field engineering activities    What You Bring   Proven experience leading Data and/or ML engineering or platform‑facing teams  Strong hands‑on background in:  Data Engineering (Spark, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse architectures)  Machine Learning practices      Experience working with cloud platforms and orchestration tools (Airflow, ADF, Databricks Workflows)  Solid understanding of modern data architectures and scalable system design  Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous user needs into structured, production‑ready solutions  Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non‑technical audiences  Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership capabilities  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field  Advanced English    Bonus Points For   Experience supporting large‑scale data platform adoption in global environments  Familiarity with ML tooling ecosystems (MLflow, Databricks ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI)  Strong track record in coaching senior engineers and building high‑performing teams  Product mindset and understanding of data platform lifecycle and user journeys    Why This Role Matters  This is not a traditional engineering management role. It is a field leadership position , where success is measured by how effectively teams adopt and leverage the platform – through well‑designed solutions, strong adherence to standards, and meaningful user partnerships.  You will shape how data and AI are built at scale – one interaction, one solution, and one team at a time. Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Participar ativamente e colaborar em projetos que envolvam equipes de diversas áreas da companhia. title: Project PCO (Project Control Officer)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Project PCO (Project Control Officer) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We are looking for a Project PCO (Project Control Officer) who will report to the PCO Team Leader in I&T PMO’s Delivery Management Team. The Project PCO contributes to the PMO’s mission by acting as a trusted partner and advisor to the Project Managers and the PMO. The role ensures the reliability, consistency, and analysis of project performance data in order to provide a clear and objective visibility into performance, variances, and risks. Through their control and advisory role, the Project PCO supports decision‑making, adherence to commitments, and the application of the PMO standards, without being responsible for project delivery. Responsibilities Act as a delivery steering partner: Support the Project Manager in planning, updating, and analyzing project plans (schedule, cost, risks) to inform decision‑making, without taking on delivery accountability. Ensure control and consistency of project data: Validate the quality, consistency, and reliability of project information (progress, budgets, forecasts) before consolidation and reporting to the Investment & Workforce team. Provide an objective assessment of project performance and health: Analyze variances, key performance indicators, and early warning signals, and provide an independent evaluation of the project health (schedule, cost, risks, issues). Play an advisory and escalation role: Identify risks, variances, and potential deviations; proactively raise alerts and recommend corrective actions to the Project Managers and other stakeholders (Delivery Manager, Portfolio Manager, etc.). Bridge projects and the PMO: Ensure compliance with PMO standards, tools, and methodologies; contribute to reporting and governance, and facilitate effective communication between project teams and the PMO, collaborating with PMO – Investment & Workforce (budget, capacity, feasibility), PMO – Portfolio Management (portfolio oversight), PMO – Performance & Practices (standards, continuous improvement), Project Managers (delivery steering and decision support), Business stakeholders & sponsors (value, priorities, expectations).  Qualifications Education: Relevant degree or equivalent experience in project management. Experience: 8+ years in project management (manufacturing knowledge a plus). Technical skills: PM methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, hybrid), lifecycle management, Jira, Smartsheet, Power BI, risk & change management, data governance. Performance analysis and control: Ability to analyze project data and identify variances and early warning signals. Project control expertise: Strong understanding of end‑to‑end project management processes and tracking indicators (health indicators / Red Amber Green status). Advisory and influencing skills: Ability to challenge and advise Project Managers without direct authority. Communication and synthesis: Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Rigor and PMO governance: Commitment to PMO standards, processes, and traceability, supported by strong documentation practices. Languages: Advanced English proficiency required due to collaboration with stakeholders and people around the world.  Do you have other qualifications? Tell us what is unique about you that would be a great addition to the team. Location This position is based in Campinas, Brazil. Work Mode You will have the opportunity to work in hybrid mode.   #J-18808-Ljbffr
